stopping a tool call before it runs is verified on all twelve, turn-end gates on eight

published_results.value: 12 of 12 harnesses for pre-execution blocking; 8 for turn-end gates

summary: failproofai publishes no benchmark or performance results about itself: the only performance number-like claim is the README tagline 'Zero latency' with no measurement behind it. Its 'evaluations' docs describe a product feature for users' agents, not results of its own, and the CHANGELOG's 'Measured' notes are one-off bug reproductions. The one quantitative capability claim (enforcement verified on 12 harnesses, turn-end gates on 8) is backed by a daily live canary (integration-suite/) that needs Docker, vendor credentials and gateway models, and no run reports are committed.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
